records.text: Bogstrok is a humanoid of the Slave Pens who fights with Piercing Jab.
A greater bogstrok of Zangarmarsh's marshlands that saps its foes with Decayed Strength.

Naturalist Bite is one of Watcher Jhang’s druid companions, sent with the others to investigate the steam pumps. In the Slave Pens, Bite is trapped in a cage while investigating Quagmirran, the nearby fungal giant. Bite asks to be freed and promises a boon to help against Quagmirran; after the interruption, Bite offers that promised magical aid.
A Coilfang fighter who attacks warmblood foes, crying that its blood is like venom and swearing by Nazjatar's depths. It hurls heavy dynamite.
A Coilfang fighter who attacks warmblood foes, crying that its blood is like venom and swearing by Nazjatar's depths.

Mennu insists the work must continue while warning attackers that they brought this on themselves. After a kill, he says it had to be done; at death, he says he deserves it, revealing remorse alongside his resolve.
Quagmirran is a beast in the Slave Pens, described as resting in a deep pool and having three hearts.
A Coilfang champion who fights for the Master and against warmblood foes. Its venom boast and combat Frightening Shout give it a distinct battle role.
A Coilfang defender who attacks warmblood foes, crying that its blood is like venom and swearing by Nazjatar's depths. It fights with shield slams.
A Coilfang slavehandler who drives peons to work with threats and beatings, berating them as lazy and slow. In combat, he boasts that his blood is venomous.
A Coilfang soothsayer who serves as a hostile combatant, invoking Nazjatar's depths and threatening warmbloods while hurling Arcane Missiles.
A Coilfang enchantress devoted to Illidan, declaring that he reigns and fighting with entangling roots and lightning. Her combat taunts curse warmbloods and invoke Nazjatar's depths.
A Coilfang Collaborator, a fighter who cripples foes, strikes back in revenge and goes into a frenzy.
A Wastewalker slave whose words express relief at freedom, gratitude for release, and weariness from enduring pain.
Freed Wastewalker workers voice relief after prolonged pain, thank those who help them, and ask how they can repay that help. Their anger toward the naga reflects their shared captivity.
Rokmar the Crackler is a lone, named humanoid in the Slave Pens.
A Wastewalker captive endures ongoing pain and calls for help, resenting anyone who leaves them imprisoned. Their cries reflect a shared captivity.
The Coilfang Scale-Healer calls on Nazjatar's depths, threatens warmbloods, and boasts of venomous blood in battle. It casts Holy Nova during combat, matching its role as a healer among the Coilfang.
The Coilfang Tempest calls on Nazjatar's depths, threatens warmbloods, and boasts of venomous blood when attacked. Its battle cries show a hostile Coilfang fighter.
A beast kept as the pet of a Coilfang Observer, able to terrify foes with Psychic Horror.

Skar'this is a bound prisoner in the Slave Pens who seeks vengeance on Lady Vashj and her naga. He helps pursue the sacred Cudgel of Kar'desh, seeing Vashj's death as both revenge and service to Neptulon; once freed, he vows to return to Serpentshrine.
Luma Skymother is an Earthen Ring figure in the struggle against Ahune in the Slave Pens. She declares that his strength will grow no further and that his frozen reign will fail.
Numa Cloudsister is the named Earthen Ring shaman whom allies are directed to meet in the Slave Pens during the effort against Ahune.

The Earthen Ring Flamecaller helps weaken Ahune while the Ring channels its flames, warning allies to survive his minions before approaching him. During the encounter, the Flamecaller announces Ahune's retreats and expected return.
Skar'this the Summoner, a Heretic of Neptulon, channels frost. He furiously declares that no one will stop the coming of Lord Ahune.

place_records.text: You are in the Slave Pens, a Coilfang place at Serpent Lake in Zangarmarsh. Mennu the Betrayer insists that the work must go on, Rokmar the Crackler is a lone named creature, and Quagmirran, a beast with three hearts, rests in a deep pool here. Coilfang technicians fill the pens, and Wastewalker captives are still held here.
